CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD(DATEVALUE(WC_Start_Date__c) - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, DATEVALUE(WC_Start_Date__c) + 0 + 1, /* Sun:Date+0 wknd day+1 day */ 5, DATEVALUE(WC_Start_Date__c) + 2 + 1, /* Fri:Date+2 wknd days+1 day */ 6, DATEVALUE(WC_Start_Date__c) + 1 + 1, /* Sat:Date+1 wknd days+1 day */ DATEVALUE(WC_Start_Date__c) + 1 /* Default (Mon/Tue/Wed):Date+1 day */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (Next)
